Maya: quick sync: proposing a concise warmup flow so worker runtime behaves the same for safetensors, mmap, gz bundles, and manifestless blobs. aim: single state enum + tiny adapter callbacks.

Liam: summary of states?

Maya: draft: INIT -> RESOLVE -> HEADER_SCAN -> INDEX_FASTPATH? -> PREFIX_STREAM -> APPLY_PREFIX -> KVCACHE_HYDRATE -> VERIFY -> ACTIVATED (soft/hard) -> ERROR/RETRY. adapters set flags: supports_index, zero_copy, prefix_safe_bytes, requires_decrypt.

Devin: soft vs hard activation semantics?

Maya: soft=allow limited gated inference (max_unverified_tokens), hard=block until full verify. hosted default=soft, dedicated/private default=hard but configurable.

Sara: eviction/resume plan?

Maya: implement resume_token with last_applied_chunk + epoch. eviction cancels liveness token -> adapter.Cancelled -> worker records resume_token. resume_ttl enforced; beyond TTL restart full path. retries bounded.

Liam: kvcache changes?

Maya: kvcache.accept_prefix(layer,offset,blob,resume_token) -> mark entries verified=false until verify. runtime gates long-context attention when unverified.

Devin: adapter surface minimal: probe(metadata)->capabilities, open_stream(range)->stream, verify_stream(async)->result, finalize(). adapters classify errors (retryable/fatal).

infra-bot: canary: warmup-unify-2026 pushed to staging.

Sara: tests I'll run: index-first fastpath, streaming-prefix activation, mmap zero-copy, eviction+resume, encrypted shard handshake. I'll prototype safetensors adapter this sprint.

Maya: I'll draft short RFC + diagram and post later today. tag me with edgecases. :rocket:
